data.title: Nail spatula
data.summary: Hair & nail · Double-ended instrument with flat curved plates used to separate the nail plate from surrounding tissue.
data.body:
![Nail spatula](instruments/nail-spatula.jpg)

_Also called: Nail elevator_

Double-ended instrument with flat curved plates used to separate the nail plate from surrounding tissue.

## Parts
- Central handle
- Flat, rectangular, curved plates at either end

## Uses / indications
- Separating nail plate from nail bed
- Separating proximal nail fold from nail plate
- Lifting dressing from skin or punch grafts

## How to hold
Pencil grip; advance the plate under the nail with gentle to-and-fro movements.

## Sterilisation & care
Autoclave, hot air oven, 2% glutaraldehyde or boiling
